question: Patients per data release node: one row per patient
source: review of 17 Oct (rules leak), labelled by hand
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT ?x (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?n) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?x dct:conformsTo <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/2024/2> } } GROUP BY ?x

question: The data release node's IRI as a string group key
source: review of 17 Oct (rules leak), labelled by hand
sparql:

question: Code identifiers with the coding-system pin inside OPTIONAL
source: review of 17 Oct (rules leak), labelled by hand
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT ?id (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?n) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?dx rdf:type sphn:Diagnosis ; sphn:hasCode ?c . ?c sphn:hasIdentifier ?id . OPTIONAL { ?c sphn:hasCodingSystemAndVersion "ICD-10-GM 2024" } } } GROUP BY ?id

question: Code identifiers pinned inside a subquery that projects the code node
